svg.text: MIT CSAIL Research • Frontier LLM (GPT-6 Astra) Reading & Editing Neural Network Weights Directly Without Training
1. CORE PARADIGM: READING & WRITING WEIGHTS AS CODE
• Small networks with identical shapes trained on 4 different games.
• Raw weight numbers pasted directly into GPT-6 Astra's text prompt.
• No tools & no game list provided; input feature labels given.
Compiling Logic Directly Into Zeroed Networks
• Given game rules, source code, and an empty network (all weights = 0).
• Astra outputs every weight in a single reply with zero training/RL.
• Mental Model: Writes a known algorithm, then compiles it into weights.
2. HEADLINE ARCHITECTURE: HOW ASTRA EDITED QWEN3.5-0.8B
lines infinitely until token limit cutoff!
Astra compares internal states across runs:
Specific mix of numbers triggering loops
• Locates the 2 layers writing Vector v most.

Astra autonomously found WHERE & WHAT to ablate
Loops cut to ~1/3 of prior rate
FEEDBACK SEARCH LOOP: TESTING CANDIDATE EDITS
No gradients used: Astra tests edits on practice problems, scores accuracy, and keeps wins.
3. THE REALITY BEHIND THE HEADLINES: 3 CRITICAL FINDINGS
It didn't learn new math—it stopped looping.
"rescued" answer previously hit the token limit.
• When original Qwen actually finished an answer,
it was ALREADY right almost every single time.
The edit removed a behavioral blocker (infinite loops)
so Qwen could output math it already knew how to do.
Qwen's Model Card Explicitly Warns About This!
• Qwen3.5-0.8B runs in non-thinking mode by default.
• Model card warns: in thinking mode, 0.8B is highly
prone to entering infinite thinking loops.
• Paper ran ALL tests in thinking mode + used a
Low temp + thinking mode maximized looping on the
7.9% baseline; changing settings mitigates it without edits.
The Gemma Control Test & Single-Run Limit
• Authors tested Astra on a small Gemma model
that rarely gets stuck in repetition loops.
• Result: Astra's weight edits barely moved its
• Gemma makes real arithmetic errors, not loop hangs.
Weight editing can unblock a hidden ability, but
it CANNOT inject new intelligence or missing skills.
4. HOW WEIGHT-SPACE PROGRAMMING DIFFERS FROM OTHER PARADIGMS
Uses test-score search on practice set.
Analogy: Removing a brain blood clot
